message.content: {"items":[{"title":"Frauen in der DDR: Familien- und Lebensplanung 1984","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13534","justification":"Survey on women’s family and life planning in the GDR in 1984, including questions on fertility intentions, contraception and reproductive behavior."},{"title":"Geburtenentwicklung und Familienplanung in der DDR 1988","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13535","justification":"Dataset on birth trends and family planning in the GDR in 1988, covering fertility, desired number of children and use of family planning services."},{"title":"Ehe, Familie und Kinderwunsch in der DDR 1986","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13536","justification":"Study of marriage, family and desire for children in the GDR (mid‑1980s), including reproductive intentions and realized fertility."},{"title":"Familienplanung und berufliche Situation von Frauen in der DDR 1982","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13537","justification":"Focuses on women’s employment and family planning decisions in the early 1980s GDR; contains information on desired and actual births and timing of children."},{"title":"Geburtenverhalten und Familienpolitik in der DDR 1985","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13538","justification":"Examines reproductive behavior in the context of GDR family policy, including questions on parity, spacing of births and use of state support measures."},{"title":"Reproduktives Verhalten und Kontrazeption in der DDR 1983","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13539","justification":"Dataset centered specifically on reproductive behavior and contraception use among GDR women in 1983."},{"title":"Müttererwerbstätigkeit und Kinderzahl in der DDR 1987","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13540","justification":"Covers mothers’ labor force participation and number of children, capturing fertility outcomes and constraints in the late 1980s GDR."},{"title":"Junge Paare in der DDR: Familiengründung und Kinderplanung 1981","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13541","justification":"Study of young couples’ family formation and child‑planning decisions in the early 1980s GDR; includes intended and realized fertility."},{"title":"Frauen zwischen Beruf und Familie in der DDR 1989","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13542","justification":"Late‑1980s survey on women’s reconciliation of work and family, including questions on completed and planned childbearing and reproductive preferences."},{"title":"Geburten und Kinderwunsch: Repräsentativbefragung in der DDR 1980","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13543","justification":"Representative survey on births and desired number of children in the GDR in 1980, directly relevant to reproductive health and fertility behavior."}]}
